newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TONGA BACKS OUTCLASS EASTERN PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TONGA BACKS OUTCLASS EASTERN PROVINCE.

text.p: Tonga showed enough skill among their backs to outclass an Eastern Province invitation side 34-19 in their second South African tour game on Sunday.
The Tongans outscored their opponents by five tries to three, and thanks to incisive running by left wing Fepi Tatafu, scorer of two tries, they led 15-5 at halftime.

Soon after the break the visitors stretched their lead to 27-5 before Eastern Province showed more cohesion among their forwards for lock Cecil du Plessis and prop Willie Enslin to cross for tries and reduce the deficit to 27-19 with 10 minutes remaining.
But Tongan flyhalf Siua Taumalolo sealed victory for the touring team when he broke through the defence for a try to clinch Tonga's first victory on their South African visit.

Tonga - Gustavo Tonga; Semisi Faka'osifolau; Viliami Uhi; Chris Schumkel; Fepi Tatafu; Siua Taumalolo; Semi Tulikifanga; Kilioni Tu'ipulotu; Maama Molitika; Loni Katoa (Heamani Lavaka 70); Kuli Faletau; 'Alipate Ta'ufo'ou; Damien Penisini; Fe'ao Vunipola; Ngaslu Tau (Latiume Maka 50).

Eastern Province invitation XV - Theo van Rensburg; Ricardo Loubscher; Ronnie Fourie; Clinton van Rensburg (Deon Kayser 50); Henry Pedro; Clive Terre'blanche (Morne Loxton 55); Chad Alcock; Sam Scott-Young; Matthew Webber (Andile Nyembezi 59); Fred Tiema; Cecil du Plessis; Adri Geldenhuys; Morne van der Merwe (Danie Saayman 50); Marius Winter; Willie Enslin.
